rows.grounds: genitive compound denoting duties pertaining to the family or lineage
particle marking the cited term as an example in enumeration
term indicating continuation of similar items beyond those named

items.question: How does the enumeration of prescribed rites extend to include family duties?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate specific rites and life-stage duties.
The expression kula+dharmasya names family duty as an included category.
The term ādi signals that further similar obligations are implied.
items.inference: Family duties and comparable obligations are included within the prescribed actions.
uncertainties: The full scope of items implied by ādi is not specified.
items.plain_english: and so forth, such as family duties.
